A GUIDE, NOT A VERDICT

Finding words for a feeling.

Choose a ten-question quick check-in with 16 possible matches, or a 42-question in-depth check-in with 34. The longer path explores body sensations, thought patterns, relationships and circumstances. Both use hand-written matching rules; extra questions add detail, not clinical validity.

In the longer check-in, defining emotional cues carry more weight than nonspecific physical sensations. Sleep, discomfort, physical needs, possible physical influences and duration are optional context and do not change the ranking. Physical experiences can have many causes; this app cannot determine them.

The closest match and three alternatives are suggestions. This questionnaire has not been clinically validated, and the rankings are not probabilities or a mental health assessment. A close result can reflect overlapping feelings.

Background reading: NHS: physical and mental signs of stress. This source informs the distinction between symptoms and context; it does not validate this questionnaire or its scoring.

Only you can decide which words fit. Your answers stay in this tab’s memory and disappear when you reload or close it.
